sources.title: GitHub - Tencent-Hunyuan/Hy-MT2
sources.snippet: Model Introduction Hy-MT2 is a family of "fast-thinking" multilingual translation models designed for complex real-world scenarios. It includes three model sizes: 1.8B, 7B, and 30B-A3B (MoE), all of which support translation among 33 languages and effectively follow translation instructions in multiple languages.

sources.title: Hy-MT2: High-Performance Multilingual Translation Model
sources.snippet: On 2026-05-21, Tencent Hunyuan released the Hy-MT2 multilingual translation model, supporting translation across 33 languages. Its 7B and 30B-A3B models achieve the best open-source results across translation tasks, surpassing models tens of times larger; the lightweight 1.8B model even beats mainstream commercial APIs such as Microsoft and Doubao.

sources.title: Hy-MT2-1.8B | AI/ML API Documentation
sources.snippet: Hy-MT2-1.8B is a compact 1.8B-parameter translation model from Tencent. It supports 33 language pairs and five Chinese dialect and minority-language pairs, with workflows for structured, delimiter-based, contextual, glossary-based, and style-guided translation.
